QuestInfo.name: [Ellin Forest] The Broken Time Control
QuestInfo.0: See #bKaren#k, the administrator of the Helios Tower #bTime Control Room#k on the 100th Floor, and say you want to use the Gate of Time.
QuestInfo.1:
Karen refused, saying that crossing the Gate of Time is very dangerous and is not something the Goddess would allow.
Wouldn't she allow you to use the Gate of Time if you said it's to investigate the strange phenomenon witnessed by Wiz the Librarian?
Return to #bWiz the Librarian#k in #bHelios Tower Library#k and obtain the <Chronicles of Ellin Forest>.
QuestInfo.2:
You obtained the #b<Chronicles of Ellin Forest>#k from Wiz the Librarian.
He requested that you take the history book when crossing the Gate of Time as it will be helpful when traveling in the past.

0.msg: (Go to #bWiz the Librarian#k in #bHelios Tower Library#k and get the Chronicles of Ellin Forest.)
